snippets.snippet: RESOLUTION 2025-089, exhibit A RULES, REGULATIONS, and FEES for JEFFERSON TOWNSHIP PARKS Section 1. General Park Regulations 1.1 Park Hours and Access. Jefferson Township Parks (“Parks”) are open to the public daily from sunrise to sunset. Except for activities explicitly approved by the Township, all Parks shall be closed from sunset until sunrise. No person may enter, remain upon, or attempt to access any portion of park property while closed. The Township may temporarily close all or portions of a park due to weather, safety, maintenance, or other operational needs. Visitors must comply with all posted or announced closures and with instructions issued by authorized Township personnel. 1.2 Protection of Property & Natural Resources. Launching or operating aircraft, drones, ultralights, gliders, balloons, remote-controlled cars or boats, or similar devices is prohibited without prior written Township approval, except in emergency situations. 1.9 Horses and Large Animals. Horses, ponies, or other large animals are not permitted in the parks unless in areas specifically designated by the Township or as part of a Township-authorized program or event. 1.10 Alcoholic Beverages. Possession or consumption of alcoholic beverages within the Parks is prohibited unless approved in writing by the Township. 1.11 Firearms and Weapons. Reckless handling, brandishing, threatening display, or discharge of a firearm within Township Parks is prohibited. Non-profit youth organizations may camp overnight with prior authorization between April 1 and November 30. Adopted December 15, 2021 Resolution 2021-096 exhibit A JEFFERSON TOWNSHIP BLOCK PARTY RULES & REGULATIONS The following rules and regulations shall apply for all block parties in Jefferson Township. A block party is a party for which the street and sidewalks may be temporarily closed to routine traffic. No State Route, Arterial or Collector Street (as defined by the Franklin County throughfare plan) may be used for a block party. Only local (development) residential streets may have block parties. Block party permits will only be issued to a resident or residents of the street on which the party occurs. Before holding a block party, a permit must first be obtained from the Township (www.jeffersontownship.org).
